_doc: Built-in defaults. Don't edit this file: put overrides in ~/.crew/config.json (or $CREW_CONFIG), by hand or with `crew.py set-role` / `crew.py set-agent`. Your file is merged over this one key by key. Role agents are fallback lists: the first installed candidate is used, skipping the calling agent's own vendor when another candidate is installed. Claude agents use full model ids, because Claude Code's short aliases can lag a release (claude 2.1.286 still maps 'haiku' to Haiku 4.5).

review.about: Code review of a diff (--target uncommitted | commit:<sha> | base:<branch>). Can build and run tests; repository changes are flagged.

check.about: Second opinion on a plan, claim, design or specific code. Can build and run tests to back its findings.

implement.about: Bounded implementation. Edits the working tree, never commits; the caller checks the result and commits.

implement-light.about: Cheap mechanical work: boilerplate, fixtures, test scaffolding, docs from code.

research.about: Web research and documentation lookups. Answers with sources.

light.about: Light read-only work: summarise files or logs, draft prose, simple lookups.
